'''Shadow Burst''' is the second tier [[Shadow spell]] from the [[Ancient Magicks]] spellbook, available at level 64 [[Magic]]. It is capable of hitting up to 18 damage (without any [[magic damage]] boosts) per cast.

Shadow Burst has the ability to lower your target's [[Attack]] level by 10%, this effect '''does not''' stack to lower the target's Attack level to zero. It is also able to target up to nine targets in a 3x3 grid around its primary target, just like all other [[Burst spells|burst]] and [[barrage spells]].

As with all [[Ancient Magicks]] spells, the [[Desert Treasure I]] quest is required to cast this spell.

When used against the [[Abyssal Sire]], Shadow Burst has a 50% chance of disorienting it for the first phase of the fight.
